title: Signal Processing Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build from mathematics, signals and systems into digital signal processing, statistical methods, image/audio processing, communications, embedded DSP and eventually advanced signal-processing systems.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. from 2026–2030. If a four-year honours/research pathway is available, use the additional depth for advanced DSP, statistical signal processing, computer vision, radar, wireless communications or research.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build mathematics, signals and systems, DSP, programming and simulation skills through progressively harder projects.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Move into DSP, audio, image/video, wireless, radar, embedded DSP or algorithm engineering.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward senior algorithm, DSP or signal-processing systems engineering and technical ownership.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine signal processing with AI/ML, edge computing, sensing, advanced communications and specialised hardware.

rows.text: Engineering mathematics, calculus, linear algebra, probability and programming
Mathematical programming exercises + small Python projects
Signals and systems, continuous/discrete signals, convolution and Fourier analysis
Digital signal processing, sampling, DFT/FFT, digital filters
MATLAB/Python DSP, statistical signal processing and spectral analysis
Image/audio/video processing or communication signal processing
Embedded DSP, optimisation, real-time processing and hardware interfaces

blocks.text: 4-year honours variant
Use additional academic depth for advanced DSP, adaptive filtering, statistical signal processing, machine learning for signals, radar, computer vision, wireless communications or research.
Specialisation lanes

rows.text: Audio features, filtering, speech, acoustic analysis

blocks.text: Continue developing expertise in AI-assisted signal processing, edge inference, sensor fusion, radar, wireless systems, computer vision, autonomous systems and specialised DSP hardware.
